title: Witty Alien vs Magnus Carlsen: round two
post: Nah, I'd win 🤞 Witty Alien threw his own gambit at Magnus Carlsen. #chess #wittyalien #magnuscarlsen #aliengambit #jujutsukaisen #chesscom

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: He beat Magnus Carlsen. Then he asked for round two.
